svg.title: Peblo AI Hub: MCP tool call waiting for approval
svg.desc: Mid-fidelity wireframe of an AI Hub chat where the model has run a read tool automatically, the user approved a write to a Peblo task, and a Google Calendar create_event call (via Peblo Connect) waits for approval with its exact arguments and what data leaves the device. Right: the Tools in this chat panel with per-tool permissions and an activity timeline.
svg.text: Move my DBMS lab viva to Thursday 2 pm, update
the task, and add it to my Google Calendar.
I found the viva in your tasks. Three steps: find it, move it, then add it to Google Calendar.
The assistant wants to create this event in your Google Calendar:
Bring record book. Created from Peblo.
Leaves this device: only the 5 fields above are sent to Google. No notes are attached.
Paused: waiting for your approval. The model will continue after you decide.
Tab to move between Approve, Always allow and Deny
What the AI may use here. Defaults live in Connections.
